name: cursor-claude-code-bridge
description: Run Claude Code inside Cursor on your Claude subscription (no API key), via the official claude CLI.

commands.title: Claude Code: Show Cursor Endpoint Info
Claude Code: Copy Agent MCP Config
Claude Code: Open Bridge Log File

claudeCodeBridge.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `claude` CLI binary. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH.

claudeCodeBridge.cwd.description: Working directory for the claude process. Leave empty to use the first workspace folder.

claudeCodeBridge.model.markdownDescription: Model used by both the chat panel and the Cursor endpoint. Change it via the status bar item or the **Claude Code: Select Model** command.

claudeCodeBridge.openaiEndpoint.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Off by default.** The everyday way to use this extension is the **Claude Code sidebar panel**, which needs no endpoint. Enable this only for the advanced path: a local, loopback-only OpenAI-compatible endpoint so **Cursor's native chat** can reach the bridge (register the `*-bridge` models as custom OpenAI models pointed at the endpoint's base URL — which also requires exposing it via a public tunnel, since Cursor's cloud refuses loopback URLs).

**Note:** routing subscription auth through a local shim is flagged as an Anthropic ToS non-goal in the project's architecture doc.

claudeCodeBridge.openaiEndpoint.port.markdownDescription: TCP port for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (bound to `127.0.0.1`). Base URL becomes `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1`.

claudeCodeBridge.openaiEndpoint.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token required on requests to the endpoint. Leave empty to accept any key (safe on loopback). If set, use the same value as the API key when adding the custom model in Cursor.

claudeCodeBridge.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Permission mode passed to `claude --permission-mode`. In non-interactive mode, tools that need approval are denied under `default`; use `acceptEdits` or `auto` to let Claude Code act. `bypassPermissions` skips all checks — use only in trusted workspaces.

claudeCodeBridge.enableToolBridge.description: Expose this IDE's `vscode.lm` extension tools to Claude Code via a local MCP server. Automatically disabled if the IDE does not support the Language Model Tools API.

claudeCodeBridge.includeEditorContext.description: Prepend the active file, selection, and diagnostics to each prompt (per-message toggle also available in the chat panel).

claudeCodeBridge.allowedTools.description: Extra tool patterns to pass to `claude --allowedTools` (e.g. "Bash(git *)", "Edit"). The bridge's own MCP tools are allowed automatically.
